text: Which genes with enhanced ovary expression are enhanced in ovarian stromal or granulosa cells (single-cell), have no detectable mRNA in testis, and are not secreted into the blood?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Ovary / Tissue enhanced AND Cell type category (scRNA): Granulosa cells, Ovarian stromal cells / Cell type enhanced AND Tissue category (RNA): Testis / Not detected AND NOT Secretome annotation: Secreted to blood
understanding: The query seeks genes showing enhanced RNA expression in ovary, cell-type enhancement in ovarian stromal or granulosa cells based on single-cell RNA-seq, no detectable mRNA expression in testis, and exclusion from proteins secreted into the blood.

trail.why: The requirement specifically specifies 'enhanced ovary expression', corresponding to tissue 'ovary' and category 'Tissue enhanced'.

trail.requirement: enhanced in ovarian stromal or granulosa cells (single-cell)
trail.why: The requirement specifically looks for genes enhanced in ovarian stromal or granulosa cells, corresponding to 'Cell type enhanced' for the cell types 'Granulosa cells' and 'Ovarian stromal cells'.

trail.requirement: have no detectable mRNA in testis
trail.why: The requirement specifies no detectable mRNA in testis, which corresponds to selecting 'testis' at Level 1 and 'Not detected' (mRNA below the 1 nTPM detection cut-off for that tissue) at Level 2.

trail.requirement: are not secreted into the blood
trail.why: The requirement asks to identify genes that are secreted into the blood so that they can be excluded from the query.

requirements.why: It defines tissue RNA specificity and distribution categories across human tissues, including ovary.

requirements.requirement: enhanced in ovarian stromal or granulosa cells (single-cell)
requirements.why: It defines single-cell RNA specificity categories across single-cell types, which includes both 'Ovarian stromal cells' and 'Granulosa cells'.

requirements.requirement: have no detectable mRNA in testis
requirements.why: It classifies consensus RNA expression and specificity per tissue (including testis), allowing selection of genes not detected at the mRNA level.

requirements.requirement: are not secreted into the blood
requirements.why: It categorizes predicted secreted proteins by destination, including 'Secreted to blood', which must be excluded using NOT.
